Home / VEU Program

Save more with the Victorian Energy Upgrades (VEU) Program.

Make your home more energy-efficient and comfortable. VWDN helps Victorian homeowners and businesses explore energy-efficient heating and cooling upgrades through available government incentives. Upgrade your old heating or cooling system to an energy-efficient reverse-cycle air conditioner and enjoy improved comfort while potentially reducing your energy bills.

Call us today · 0485 075 370

The program

What is the VEU Program?

The Victorian Energy Upgrades (VEU) Program is a Victorian Government initiative designed to help households and businesses reduce energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions.

Through this program, eligible Victorians can access discounts on selected energy-efficient products and upgrades, making it more affordable to improve their properties.

One of the key areas covered is heating and cooling. Eligible property owners may receive discounts when upgrading older, less-efficient systems to approved reverse-cycle air conditioners. At VWDN, we make the upgrade process straightforward by helping you understand available options, product requirements and installation arrangements.

Benefits

Why consider a VEU energy upgrade?

Lower energy bills

Modern energy-efficient air conditioners can use less electricity than older, inefficient heating and cooling systems.

Government discounts

Eligible installations may receive upfront discounts through the Victorian Energy Upgrades Program.

Year-round comfort

Reverse-cycle air conditioning provides both heating and cooling throughout the year.

Environmentally friendly

Energy-efficient systems help reduce electricity consumption and greenhouse gas emissions.

Improved home efficiency

Replace outdated heating and cooling equipment with modern technology designed for better energy performance.

Find out if you qualify

Tell us about your current system and we'll help you check.

Eligibility

Who is eligible for the VEU Program?

You may be eligible for discounts if your property meets the relevant program requirements. Eligibility depends on the type of upgrade, existing heating or cooling equipment, replacement system and property conditions.

  • Your property must be located in Victoria.
  • The existing heating or cooling system must meet the relevant replacement requirements.
  • The new air conditioning system must be an approved VEU product.
  • The installation must be completed through an appropriately accredited provider or an authorised installation arrangement.
  • Renters may also be eligible, subject to landlord approval where required.

Important: eligibility and discount amounts vary depending on the upgrade activity and current VEU requirements. Contact us to discuss your circumstances.

Home / Aircon

Air conditioning heating & cooling rebates in Victoria.

Looking to replace your old heating or cooling system? With the VEU Program, eligible Victorian households and businesses can access discounts on energy-efficient reverse-cycle air conditioning. Whether you're considering a split system, multi-head or ducted system, we'll help you understand your options and available discounts.

Call 0485 075 370

The rebate

What is the Victorian air conditioning rebate?

Under the VEU Program, eligible customers can receive discounts when installing approved, high-efficiency reverse-cycle air conditioning systems that provide both heating and cooling.

By replacing an older, inefficient system with an approved alternative, you may be able to:

  • Reduce your upfront installation costs.
  • Improve your home's energy efficiency.
  • Reduce electricity consumption.
  • Enjoy efficient heating and cooling throughout the year.
  • Reduce your household's environmental impact.

The discount is generally applied upfront through the accredited provider, subject to eligibility and program requirements.

How much can you save?

Indicative household discounts.

The discount depends on your existing heating system, the new air conditioner, its capacity and the type of installation.

Room reverse-cycleUp to$1,610

On eligible room reverse-cycle air conditioning upgrades, such as replacing a gas heater.

Ducted reverse-cycleUp to$5,530

On eligible ducted reverse-cycle upgrades, such as replacing a gas ducted heater.

Discount amounts are indicative maximums, not guaranteed savings. The actual discount depends on the equipment being replaced, the approved replacement product and the applicable VEU requirements. Program rates and eligibility requirements can change.

System types

Types of air conditioning systems.

The VEU Program covers eligible high-efficiency reverse-cycle systems, including selected ducted and non-ducted models.

Split system air conditioners

An indoor unit and an outdoor compressor, ideal for bedrooms, living areas and home offices.

  • Individual room temperature control
  • Heating and cooling in one system
  • Modern, energy-efficient options

Multi-head split systems

Multiple indoor units connected to one outdoor unit, for several rooms without an outdoor unit for each.

  • Control temperatures in different rooms
  • One outdoor unit, multiple indoor units
  • Flexible installation options

Ducted reverse-cycle

A central unit connected to ducts and ceiling outlets for whole-home climate control.

  • Heating and cooling across multiple rooms
  • Centralised temperature control
  • Discreet ceiling outlets

Eligibility

Who is eligible?

Victorian households and businesses may qualify. Renters can also be eligible, although landlord approval may be required before installation. Eligibility is assessed case by case.

  • Your property must be located in Victoria.
  • The new system must be an approved, high-efficiency reverse-cycle air conditioner.
  • The system must provide both heating and cooling.
  • The product must meet the relevant VEU technical specifications.
  • If replacing an existing system, the property must meet the applicable age requirements.
  • The installation must be arranged through a VEU-accredited provider or an authorised installer working with one.

Home / Heatpump

Heat pump hot water system rebates in Victoria.

Thinking about replacing your old electric or gas hot water system? Through the VEU Program and the Solar Homes hot water rebate, eligible Victorian households can access discounts that reduce the upfront cost of upgrading. We help you choose a suitable system, understand incentives and arrange professional installation.

Call 0485 075 370

The technology

What is a heat pump hot water system?

An energy-efficient alternative to traditional electric and gas water heaters. Instead of generating heat directly, it uses electricity to extract heat from the surrounding air and transfer it to the water in its tank.

Why upgrade?

  • Uses less electricity than conventional electric storage systems.
  • Can help reduce household energy bills.
  • Helps reduce greenhouse gas emissions.
  • Works well alongside existing solar panels.
  • Modern models offer smart controls and scheduling.

Government rebates

Incentives you may be able to combine.

Each program has its own eligibility conditions.

VEU ProgramUpfront discount

When replacing an existing electric or gas hot water system with an approved heat pump. The amount depends on the existing heater, the product and program requirements.

Solar VictoriaUp to$1,000

Or up to $1,400 for selected locally made products. Calculated as 50% of the product price after other discounts. Income, property and other conditions apply.

Federal STCsCertificate value

Small-scale Technology Certificates reduce the upfront price, usually passed on as a discount by the installer.

For eligible locally made products, combined VEU and Solar Homes incentives can reach up to $1,960, before any applicable STC benefit. These are maximum potential incentives, not guaranteed discounts. Your savings depend on your existing system, product selection, property eligibility and current program requirements.

VEU eligibility

  • Your property must be located in Victoria.
  • You must have an existing hot water system to replace.
  • The property must generally be at least two years old.
  • The heat pump must be an approved VEU product meeting technical and warranty requirements.
  • Installed through an accredited provider or authorised installation arrangement.
  • Private rental properties may also qualify.

Solar Victoria eligibility

  • Owner-occupier of an existing property.
  • Combined taxable household income below $150,000 a year.
  • Property valued below $3 million.
  • Replacing a hot water system at least three years old.
  • Eligible product installed through an authorised Solar Victoria retailer.
  • Previous-rebate restrictions apply.

How it works

Like a fridge, in reverse.

  1. Absorbing heat

    A fan draws in surrounding air, and refrigerant absorbs its heat through the evaporator.

  2. Compressing

    The compressor raises the refrigerant's pressure and temperature.

  3. Heating the water

    The hot refrigerant transfers its energy to the water through a heat exchanger.

  4. Storing hot water

    Heated water is stored in an insulated tank, ready to use.

Choosing a size

The right capacity for your household.

It depends on household size, daily hot water use, installation space and budget.

200L

Smaller households

Suits moderate daily hot water requirements.

250L – 270L

Medium households

For homes that need a larger hot water supply.

300L – 315L

Larger households

For bigger families with higher daily hot water use.

Home / Waterfilter

Whole house water filtration systems in Melbourne.

Enjoy cleaner, better-quality water throughout your home. A whole house filtration system filters water as it enters your property, supplying filtered water to your kitchen taps, showers, laundry and other connected outlets.

Call 0485 075 370

The system

What is whole house water filtration?

It's installed at the main water supply entry point of your property. Unlike an under-sink filter that treats one tap, it filters incoming water before it travels through your plumbing.

Filtered water can be supplied to:

  • Kitchen taps
  • Bathroom showers and basins
  • Laundry taps
  • Toilets and other connected outlets

How it works

Filtered in stages.

  1. Sediment filtration

    Captures larger particles such as sand, dirt, rust and sediment.

  2. Carbon filtration

    Activated carbon helps reduce chlorine, unpleasant tastes and odours.

  3. Additional filtration

    Depending on the system, further media can target specific substances.

Benefits

Why filter the whole house?

Cleaner water everywhere

Filtered water from multiple taps and outlets, not just one under-sink filter.

Less chlorine and odour

Carbon filtration can improve the taste and smell of household water.

Reduces sediment

Captures dirt, sand and rust before they enter your plumbing.

Better showers

Reduced chlorine and odours make everyday showers more pleasant.

Protects appliances

Less particulate matter reaching fixtures and connected appliances.

One central solution

A single system treats incoming water for the whole property.

What it can remove

Depending on the system.

Not all systems remove the same substances. To target specific contaminants such as lead, fluoride, bacteria or dissolved salts, check the manufacturer's independently verified performance data.

  • Chlorine
  • Sediment, sand and dirt
  • Rust particles
  • Unpleasant tastes and odours
  • Selected chemical contaminants

  1. Discuss requirements

    Tell us about your property, water use and any quality concerns.

    Explore options suited to your water supply and preferred technology.

  3. Plan the install

    Checked for leaks, correct operation and water flow before use.
